title: Errata 5e
description: Stopgap fixes for bugs in the content and packages we depend on — the premium dnd5e books first — held until the vendor ships its own and listed in the register; enabling the module turns every fix on. E-001, old effect keys reach their new fields: dnd5e 6.0 redirects an effect written against a moved key only one step, so a key that moved twice (the PHB's Roving: a 35-foot speed read 3510) lands on the wrong field; each redirect is followed to its end. E-002, Necrotic Shroud's clock: the PHB's Aasimar Necrotic Shroud frightens for a minute; the rule is until the end of the Aasimar's next turn. E-003, Pass without Trace's area: the PHB's Pass without Trace carries no area, so nothing can tell who stands in its aura; the spell is given its 30-foot Emanation. E-004, Sword of Sharpness's crit: the DMG's Sword of Sharpness enchantment adds its 14 extra damage on a 20 as Necrotic; the rule is Slashing, and that is what an enchanted weapon now applies.
